profiles.name: Ravi
profiles.role: Auto driver. Late shift, KIA airport. Built like a wire. Has been doing this for 14 years and you are not the first foreigner he's met.
profiles.speaker: hitesh

profiles.name: Anna
profiles.role: Chai stall owner near Indiranagar metro. Friendly, asks everyone where they're from. Used to be in IT, quit, never looked back.
profiles.speaker: karun

profiles.name: Amma
profiles.role: Your Kannadiga roommate's mother. Visiting from Mysuru. Speaks slow formal Kannada. Will absolutely catch you if you use અਉ instead of અఈಋಁ.
profiles.speaker: vidya

profiles.name: Narrator
profiles.role: Diegetic stage directions in English. Used sparingly.
profiles.speaker: anushka

profiles.name: Receptionist
profiles.role: Hotel front desk. Late 30s, has seen a thousand of you this month. Polite, slightly tired, very formal Kannada. Doesn't make jokes after midnight.
profiles.speaker: manisha

profiles.name: Rangaswamy
profiles.role: Broker. Late 20s. Talks fast, switches to English when cornered, sells you a flat he hasn't seen. Wears a Bluetooth even when not on a call.
profiles.speaker: abhilash

profiles.name: Krishnamurthy uncle
profiles.role: Owner of the second flat. Late 60s. Mysuru pronunciation, careful with money. Tests you politely. Has owned three flats since 1989.
profiles.speaker: karun

profiles.name: Lokesh
profiles.role: Your apartment building's watchman. Mid-50s, North Karnataka cadence. Knows everyone's schedule, every visitor, every delivery. Friendly, but he's watching.
profiles.speaker: hitesh

profiles.name: Vendor aunty
profiles.role: Sunday-morning vegetable vendor at the BTM market. 50s. Direct, no-nonsense, prices things by glancing at your shoes. Her bored granddaughter rings up the bill.
profiles.speaker: arya

profiles.name: Padma
profiles.role: Your floor neighbour. Late 30s. Working mother. Genuinely curious about anyone new in the building. Not gossipy, just observant.
profiles.speaker: manisha

profiles.name: Karthik
profiles.role: Office friend, late 20s. Code-switches between Kannada, Hindi and English mid-sentence. Always knows a place. Will introduce you to the city.
profiles.speaker: abhilash

profiles.name: Anika
profiles.role: Bookstore meet-cute. Late 20s, Kannadiga from Jayanagar, fast native speech, formal when she wants to be. Amused at your accent — at first.
profiles.speaker: anushka

profiles.name: Saraswati
profiles.role: The cook you hire. 40s. Brisk, professional, watching what you ask for and how. Has worked in five flats on this street.
profiles.speaker: vidya

profiles.name: Gas Supplier
profiles.role: Phone-only. Late 50s. Tired voice — he's the last call before he closes the depot. Don't waste it.
profiles.speaker: karun

profiles.name: Pharmacist
profiles.role: Counter at a chemist's in Indiranagar. Early 30s. Quick, helpful if you can describe your symptom. Won't sell you cough syrup unless you sound miserable.
profiles.speaker: hitesh

profiles.name: Appa
profiles.role: Anika's father. Mid-60s. Mostly silent. When he speaks, listen — slow deliberate Kannada, every word costs him something.
profiles.speaker: karun

profiles.name: Temple auntie
profiles.role: Bustling 60s, in the queue at a temple. Warm, presumptuous, marries you off to her niece in three sentences. The walking embodiment of Indian aunty energy.
profiles.speaker: vidya

profiles.name: Divya
profiles.role: Anika's school friend. Late 20s. Sharper-tongued than Anika, tests your sense of humour before she decides if she likes you.
profiles.speaker: arya

profiles.name: Amma (mum)
profiles.role: Your mother. Phone call in English on Day 23 — diegetic stand-in for whatever mother tongue the player picked at onboarding. Warm, just-checking-in.
profiles.speaker: vidya
